title: A complete 7/2 linear lower bound for one uniform family with a field description in the input

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total family F_n defined in proof.md: F_n=0 for n<1024. For n>=1024 let k be the least prime with k^5>32*n^3, m=n-k, r=ceil(m/k), and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). The first k input bits encode the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-k binary polynomial q. Output 0 if q is reducible. Otherwise form K=F_2[Z]/(q), pad the remaining m input bits with zeros to r*k bits, and interpret the blocks z_i in the polynomial basis, constant coefficient first. Set y_i=z_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1) and output Tr_(K/F_2)(sum over t-element I subset {1,...,r} of product_(i in I) y_i). The field description is part of the actual n-bit input. The fixed evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier are specified in proof.md.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time Boolean family, hence one language in NP with witness bound zero, C_B2(F_n)>=(7/2)(n-k)-7*d(n)>=(7/2)n-(469/4)n^(4/5) for every integer n>=1024, where d(n)=ceil(k*r/t)+k*t+r*(r+1)+1. Therefore liminf over all integer lengths n of C_B2(F_n)/n >= 7/2 in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|. Equivalently, for every real epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that every integer n>=N_epsilon satisfies C_B2(F_n)>=(7/2-epsilon)*n.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
